telemetry.repeated_file_reads_unavailable_reason: Codex JSONL does not expose a filesystem I/O trace; command text cannot establish actual reads
telemetry.file_read_method: Heuristic command-intent proxy from successful command_execution items containing literal cat, sed -n, head, tail, or rg commands with explicit file-like paths. Shell expansion, scripts, directory searches, MCP reads, and internal reads are excluded. A repeated command names a path recognized in an earlier command. Unquoted shell newlines are command separators; quoted newlines stay argument data and are excluded as paths. This is not an I/O trace, an actual read count, or a guaranteed lower bound on filesystem reads.
